description: This file defines the Program class in the OpenMRS project, representing a healthcare program with associated workflows, concepts, and properties. It includes constructors, accessors, and mutator methods, as well as logic to manage workflows and retrieve them by name or ID.

classes.name: Program
classes.description: Represents a healthcare program within the OpenMRS system, including its associated concepts, workflows, and metadata.

methods.name: addWorkflow
methods.description: Adds a new ProgramWorkflow to this Program, setting its program reference.

methods.name: removeWorkflow
methods.description: Removes a specified ProgramWorkflow from this Program and clears its program reference.

methods.name: getWorkflowByName
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflow by name, matching any locale.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Program, including id, concept, and workflows.

methods.name: getConcept
methods.description: Gets the concept associated with this program.

methods.name: setConcept
methods.description: Sets the concept associated with this program.

methods.name: getOutcomesConcept
methods.description: Returns the concept representing possible outcomes.

methods.name: setOutcomesConcept
methods.description: Sets the concept representing possible outcomes.

methods.name: getWorkflows
methods.description: Returns a set of active (non-retired) workflows.

methods.name: getWorkflow
methods.description: Retrieves a workflow by its ID.

methods.name: getAllWorkflows
methods.description: Returns all workflows, including retired ones.

methods.name: setAllWorkflows
methods.description: Sets the collection of all workflows.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Gets the unique identifier (alias for getProgramId).

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier (alias for setProgramId).
